chunks.text:
Between natural notes, E–F and B–C are half steps. E–F♯ is a whole step.
For a parallel natural minor scale, keep the major scale’s tonic and lower its third, sixth and seventh degrees by a half step. C major becomes C natural minor: C, D, E♭, F, G, A♭, B♭. Harmonic and melodic minor alter this pattern.
Elements per side for a House/Techno:
L-R: Perc, piano, strings, pads, guitars, synths, fx, bv
M: vocals, snare, bass, kick
Effects

Call and response

Drums
UKG sketch: sixteenth-note swing delays the second note in each pair of sixteenths, giving alternating long and short intervals. The amount varies with the groove. In Live, try a swing groove and adjust its Timing amount in the Groove Pool.
Kick

Fat 909

Hats
Jacking hi-hats: a closed hi-hat followed by an open hi-hat, or vice versa.
Claps
Percussion
Syncopation
Major third
In a major key, try changing the minor iii chord to major before vi. In C major, that gives E major followed by A minor. The G♯ in E major leads up to A. In this context, E major acts as the secondary dominant of vi, written $\mathrm{V/vi}$.
